$comment: Single source of truth for which bin/tests/ files CI runs. Read by
(the coverage guard). Every bin/tests/test_*.py MUST appear in exactly
one tier — that guard is what stops a new test being silently ungated,
which is the whole defect class this manifest exists to close (ff3264f0).
Tiers were derived by MEASUREMENT, not assumption: each file was run
isolation, uid preserved) and the failures re-run with live services.
Do not move a file between tiers on reasoning alone — move it after
re-measuring, and say so in the PR.
NOTE on the harness: plain `unshare -rn` maps you to uid 0 inside the
namespace, and root bypasses permission checks — it made

service_dependent.reason: Creates and drops its own throwaway database (e2e_grants_<pid>) from a skeleton, then applies the real grant files. Needs a reachable PostgreSQL. NOTE: also latent hang — it shells out to psql with no -w and no stdin=DEVNULL, so without PGPASSWORD it blocks on an interactive password prompt forever instead of failing.
Asserts the operator-go migration is marked applied against live nebula state.
Probes the live mesh-register service over the network.
Round-trips records through the live Nebula REST API (:3101) to check tag persistence.
Exercises the live substance-service over HTTP.
Runs the real drift checker against live terrain state.

dsn_gated.reason: Raises at import: 'CONDUIT_PG_DSN must be set to run tests (PG is mandatory)'. Needs a provisioned conduit DSN against a live database, not merely a reachable server — the backfill writes rows, so it cannot be exercised against a skeleton.

Raises at import: 'CONDUIT_PG_DSN must be set to run tests (PG is mandatory)'. Exercises drift-intake against live nebula state, so it needs a provisioned conduit DSN rather than a reachable-but-empty server.

Raises at import: 'CONDUIT_PG_DSN must be set to run tests (PG is mandatory)'. The shrapnel bridge reconciles live table state, so it requires a provisioned conduit DSN and real rows to reconcile against.

known_red.reason: RED — a real defect, not a test bug. sql/ carries duplicate Flyway version prefixes (040 045 046 051 125 194); e.g. sql/V194__decommission_qbe_empty_tables.sql and sql/V194__expression_register_producer.sql both claim V194. A version-ledger runner applies one file per version and silently skips the lex-second twin on a fresh database — schema drift behind a green ledger. The guard is correct; the repo is not. Renumbering V194 needs owner intent, so it is deliberately NOT fixed here. Filed separately (see finding).
